facts.text: The resort is perched on a mountain ridge overlooking the borders of Thailand, Myanmar and Laos.
facts.excerpt: Perched on a mountain ridge overlooking the borders of Thailand, Myanmar and Laos

facts.text: The resort is set amid 160 acres of bamboo forest in northern Thailand.
facts.excerpt: set amid 160 acres of bamboo forest in northern Thailand

facts.text: The resort is approximately one hour from Chiang Rai International Airport and a five-minute drive from the historic town of Chiang Saen.
facts.excerpt: the resort is approximately one hour from Chiang Rai International Airport (CEI) and just a five-minute drive from the historic town of Chiang Saen

facts.text: Guests can spend a night in the elephants' natural habitat in a transparent Jungle Bubble under star-filled skies.
facts.excerpt: Spend an extraordinary night immersed in their natural habitat in a transparent Jungle Bubble, gazing at star-filled skies and waking to the sounds of the jungle.

facts.text: The Golden Triangle Asian Elephant Foundation is home to elephants, mahouts and their families, rescued mainly from illegal logging camps, the street or elephant shows.
facts.excerpt: The Golden Triangle Asian Elephant Foundation (GTAEF) serves as a home for elephants, mahouts and their families - rescued primarily from illegal logging camps, the street, or elephant shows.

facts.text: The resort has an elephant camp with a scientific research and conservation programme.
facts.excerpt: Award-winning elephant camp, scientific research and conservation programme

facts.text: At Canopy: Treetop Dining, intimate meals are served high among the branches with views over the surrounding wilderness.
facts.excerpt: Take dining to enchanting heights at Canopy: Treetop Dining, where intimate meals are served high among the branches with spectacular views over the surrounding wilderness.

facts.text: Rooms feature indigenous artworks, teak furnishings and organic textures.
facts.excerpt: with indigenous artworks, teak furnishings and organic textures carefully selected to encourage a sense of calm

facts.text: From the room balcony, guests can look over three countries and elephants grazing.
facts.excerpt: Gaze over three countries and elephants grazing from the comfort of your balcony.

facts.text: The Mekong Explorer Suites pay homage to the explorers who charted the Mekong River, blending Lanna traditions with colonial influences.
facts.excerpt: Mekong Explorer Suite pay homage to the intrepid explorers who charted the Mekong River centuries ago, blending the rich traditions of Lanna with elegant colonial influences.

facts.text: Each Mekong Explorer Tent has its own swimming pool and terrace with panoramic views across the Golden Triangle.
facts.excerpt: each private tent features its own swimming pool and terrace, with panoramic views across the landscapes of the Golden Triangle.

facts.text: Guests can journey through the countryside by Royal Enfield sidecar.
facts.excerpt: journey through the picturesque countryside by Royal Enfield sidecar

facts.text: Guests can drift along the Mekong River as morning mist rises, discovering the cultures and landscapes of three neighbouring countries.
facts.excerpt: drift along the Mekong River as morning mist rises from its waters, discovering the cultures and landscapes of three neighbouring countries

facts.text: The spa offers spa rituals and ancient healing practices inspired by nature.
facts.excerpt: Indulge in rejuvenating spa rituals and ancient healing practices inspired by nature

facts.text: A sauna, steam rooms and whirlpool are available, and the tennis court can be booked in advance.
facts.excerpt: Sauna, steam rooms and whirlpool are also available while tennis court can be booked in advance.

facts.text: The infinity pool has Mekong views.
facts.excerpt: The infinity pool has glorious Mekong views

facts.text: All accommodations have balconies and teak floors and are decorated with northern Thai objects and textiles.
facts.excerpt: The accommodations, all with balconies, have teak floors and are decorated with northern Thai objects and textiles.

facts.text: The hotel sits on a sylvan hillside above the Mekong River, an hour north of Chiang Rai.
facts.excerpt: setting on a sylvan hillside above the Mekong River, an hour north of Chiang Rai

facts.text: Doi Tung Royal Villa is approximately 50 minutes from the resort.
facts.excerpt: Doi Tung Royal Villa approximately 50 minutes away

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler praises the attentive, welcoming staff.
facts.excerpt: the sweet, attentive, and welcoming staff, who fall all over themselves trying to anticipate your needs

facts.text: Check-in is at 15:00.
facts.excerpt: CHECK-IN 15:00

facts.text: Check-in is from 2 pm.
facts.excerpt: Check-in from 2.00 pm and check-out is until 12.00 noon.
